geometry.name: metagrating
geometry.description: 2D beam-deflecting metagrating: silicon ridges on a SiO2 half-space, one period, out-of-plane E (Ez), normal incidence from the substrate.
notes: Derived for G7-04 from examples/meep_comparison/metagrating/geometry.json at mesh 0.04 um: 50 x 91 cells (cell size / mesh), 10 absorber cells on each y face (0.4 um), 6000 steps of the base Courant number 0.700036 (the base physical time). Source and DFT lines keep their positions in um.

Ez nodes: TorchFDTD at -L/2 + i*h, Meep at integer multiples of h from the cell centre; the two sets coincide on an axis with an even cell count and lie half a cell apart on an axis with an odd count. Here the y axis has 91 cells, so the two solvers sample the ridges and the substrate top on different rows.

TorchFDTD: Region.pml_cells is capped at 50, so the absorber is set per face with BoundaryFace(kind='pml', layers=10) on y_min and y_max (no package change); Meep: PML of pml_cells * mesh_um = 0.4 um in y.
Staircase series: no material edge lies on an Ez node at this mesh, no shift.

g7_04.rule: staircase: the whole structure (ridges and substrate top) moves by half a cell in +x and +y when a material edge lies on an Ez node of TorchFDTD or Meep; source and DFT lines stay; smoothed: no shift

grid.boundary: Meep PML (stretched-coordinate, quadratic profile by default, R_asymptotic=1e-15), 0.4 um thick

staircase.ez_node_rule: x_i = h (i - N//2), y_j = h (j - M//2): integer multiples of h from the cell centre

timing.cost: full_seconds: construction, init_sim and run of one grating solve on all ranks (barrier-bounded wall time on the master); the bare-substrate reference run is recorded separately and not counted

host.note: shared workstation: other agents use the GPU and other sessions may run CPU jobs; the Windows host CPU load (all cores) is sampled before every run and recorded; runs wait while the pause file exists and, with max_host_cpu_percent, until the load is below it (at most max_wait_seconds)
